author: Second Wind
description:
Having the good players isn't the only thing you need at the table. You need players who share expectations, goals, and play styles. James Smith from  Knights of the Smith Dinner Table and Jesse Galena from Adventure Is Nigh discuss and answer your questions about making and managing great player dynamics.

title: Player Dynamics and How to Manage Them | RPG Help Desk
